fusions.name: Settling Weight
fusions.desc: A pouncing blow that deals 30 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Shelf
fusions.desc: A swat that deals 12 damage, up to 1.6 times at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Weighted Pads
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Follow-Through
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
